title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 17: Elijah's word of drought, the ravens at the brook Cherith, and the widow of Zarephath and her son.

questions.text: Elijah the Tishbite was one of the settlers of which place?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:1 says Elijah the Tishbite was one of the settlers of Gilead.

questions.text: What did Elijah tell Ahab would not come these years, except by his word?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 17:1 Elijah tells Ahab there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to his word.

questions.text: By which brook did Yahweh tell Elijah to hide?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 17:3 Yahweh tells Elijah to hide himself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

questions.text: What did the ravens bring Elijah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:6 says the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening.

answers.text: Bread and meat, morning and evening
Figs and honey once a day

questions.text: Why did the brook dry up?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:7 says that after a while the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

answers.text: There was no rain in the land
The ravens drank all its water

questions.text: Where did Yahweh send Elijah next, to be sustained by a widow?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 17:9 Yahweh says, "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there."

answers.text: Shiloh, in the land of Ephraim

questions.text: What did the widow say she had left?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 17:12 she says she has no cake, but a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jar.

answers.text: A handful of meal and a little oil
Two loaves and a few small fish
A little barley and some honey
Nothing but water in a jar

questions.text: Until when would the jar of meal not run out and the jar of oil not fail?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 17:14 Elijah says the jar of meal will not run out and the jar of oil will not fail until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.

answers.text: Until Yahweh sends rain on the earth
Until her son is grown up

questions.text: How many times did Elijah stretch himself on the child?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:21 says he stretched himself on the child three times and cried to Yahweh.

questions.text: What did the woman say when Elijah gave her son back alive?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 17:24 the woman says, "Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh's word in your mouth is truth."

answers.text: "Now I know that you are a man of God"
"Now I will go with you to Israel"
